model_annotations.Bulgarian:
The graph illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output at a threshold of 1e-2 across different layers, comparing three distinct scenarios: before gate, after gate, and after average gate.

The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and features a linear scale, spanning from 0 to 20 in intervals of 5, with a total of 23 data points marked along the axis. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" and also employs a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 in increments of 0.2.

Three lines are plotted on the graph, each representing a different scenario. The blue dashed line corresponds to the "sparsity ratio before gate," with an average value of 0.03. This line starts at approximately 0.1 on the y-axis at layer 0 and decreases to around 0.01 by layer 10, remaining relatively stable thereafter. The orange dotted line represents the "sparsity ratio after gate," averaging 0.44. It begins at 1.0 on the y-axis at layer 0 and gradually declines to about 0.1 by layer 20, with some fluctuations observed between layers 10 and 20. The green dashed line indicates the "sparsity ratio after average gate," with an average of 0.33. Starting at 1.0 on the y-axis at layer 0, this line decreases to approximately 0.1 by layer 20, exhibiting a more pronounced decline between layers 0 and 10, followed by a relatively stable trend with minor fluctuations.

Overall, the graph provides a visual comparison of the sparsity ratios across different layers and scenarios, highlighting the variations in sparsity ratios before and after applying gates, as well as the impact of averaging gates on the output sparsity ratio.
model_annotations.Chinese: 该图展示了SDPA输出的稀疏比，阈值为1e-2，比较了门控前后的稀疏比。x轴标记为“层”，数值范围从0到21，刻度为线性，间隔为5。y轴标记为“稀疏比”，数值范围从0.0到1.0，刻度为线性，间隔为0.2。图中共有三条线：蓝色的虚线表示门控前的稀疏比，从0层的约0.1下降到第21层的约0.01；在0到6层之间迅速下降，然后趋于稳定；橙色的点线表示门控后的稀疏比，从0层的约1.0下降到第21层的约0.2，在0到10层之间迅速下降，然后趋于稳定，但在第17层之后再次下降；在第18层之后，该线显示出上升趋势，峰值出现在第19层，稀疏比约为0.33；绿色的虚线表示平均门控后的稀疏比，从0层的约1.0下降到第21层的约0.1；在0到10层之间迅速下降，然后在第10层到第17层之间趋于稳定；在第18层之后，该线显示出上升和下降的趋势，峰值出现在第19层，稀疏比约为0.17。
model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates the Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output at a Threshold of 1e-2 across different layers, comparing three distinct scenarios. The x-axis represents the Layer, with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 20, and tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis represents the Sparsity Ratio, also on a linear scale, spanning from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. Three lines are depicted: the blue dashed line representing the sparsity ratio before gate, with an average value of 0.03, starts at approximately 0.13 at layer 0, decreases to around 0.03 by layer 5, and continues to decline to about 0.01 by layer 20; the orange dotted line, representing the sparsity ratio after gate, with an average value of 0.44, begins at 1.0 at layer 0, decreases to around 0.2 by layer 10, and then remains relatively stable until layer 20; the green dashed line, representing the sparsity ratio after average gate, with an average value of 0.33, starts at 1.0 at layer 0, decreases to approximately 0.1 by layer 10, and then stabilizes until layer 20.
model_annotations.German: The diagram represents the sparsity ratio of SDPA output at a threshold of 1e-2 across different layers. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," is linear, ranges from 0 to 20 (though the diagram includes data points up to 22), and has tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio," is also linear, spans from 0.0 to 1.0, and has tick labels at intervals of 0.2. Three lines are plotted: a blue dashed line representing the "sparsity ratio before gate" with an average of 0.03, an orange dotted line for the "sparsity ratio after gate" averaging 0.44, and a green dashed line for the "sparsity ratio after average gate" with an average of 0.33. The blue line starts at approximately 0.13 at layer 0 and decreases to around 0.01 by layer 22. The orange line begins at about 1.0 at layer 0 and declines to roughly 0.15 by layer 12, before rising to approximately 0.38 by layer 22. The green line commences at around 0.98 at layer 0, decreases to about 0.12 by layer 12, and then stabilizes, ending at roughly 0.13 by layer 22.
